baseline_models.mechanism: The warning is an alarm meant to awaken caution, while saying can encode an adopted belief; the target is therefore a voiced doctrinal commitment, not a bare sound event.

activation_trace.role: Alarm that frightens into caution supplies the intervention and treats the attribution as a danger requiring wakefulness.
Speech as belief or school turns قالوا from mere vocalization into the cohort's doctrinal commitment.

changed_reading.before: A warning addressed to people who uttered a sentence.
changed_reading.after: A danger-alarm addressed to a group whose utterance embodies a held doctrine.

baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate acquisition for oneself is yoked to born descent. The allegation transfers both possessive choice and generated lineage to the worshipped God, creating an internal category collision.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition or making something one's own supplies the deliberate possessive act attributed to God.
The worshipped deity supplies the category whose relation is being redescribed by the allegation.
Born offspring supplies actual descent, making the acquired relation also a claim of lineage.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply denies that God has a child.
changed_reading.after: It rejects a relation whose wording imposes both acquisitive possession and born lineage on God.

baseline_models.mechanism: False attribution, acquisition, and produced derivation combine into a speech act that tries to install a filial category in the social account of God.

activation_trace.role: Saying what was not or attributing it supplies the fabrication performed by the speakers.
Taking or acquiring for oneself gives the fabricated relation an act of social assignment.
A derivative produced from another supplies the invented filial category that the utterance installs.

changed_reading.before: The speakers report a proposition about divine family.
changed_reading.after: Their saying performs an attempted social manufacture of a derivative divine relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The delivered written message is explicitly free of semantic bend and set upright before 18:4 names the warned attribution. The acquired-offspring relation can therefore be read as the first specified doctrinal curvature corrected by the book.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself anchors the particular relational construction that the straight message confronts.
Delivering and conveying something supplies the authorized incoming correction.
Ordered written speech supplies the stable textual measure against which the attribution is read.
Deviation of meaning from straightness, explicitly negated of the book, supplies the contrastive image of doctrinal bend.
Uprightness and rectitude make the book an active straightening standard rather than merely an unbent object.

structural_cues: 18:1 negates curvature, 18:2 calls the book upright, and 18:4 then specifies a warned claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a delivered book, negated semantic curvature, and uprightness; I infer that 18:4 names a first doctrinal bend corrected by that book. Alternatively, the straightness may characterize the book globally without singling out this claim.

changed_reading.before: The offspring claim is an isolated error.
changed_reading.after: It is the opening concrete bend exposed by an upright, curvature-free message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same warning verb is first paired with severe overpowering force and counterbalanced by glad news. Its recurrence in 18:4 specifies one liable audience, so the warning is consequence-bearing rather than a merely intellectual correction.

activation_trace.role: The focus alarm anchors the targeted warning whose force is filled out by the preceding coordination.
The repeated alarm that awakens caution links the general commission directly to the focus audience.
Overpowering severity supplies the threatened consequence carried by the warning.
Force and hardness intensify the consequence beyond verbal disapproval.
Joy-opening news supplies the coordinated positive pole, locating the focus group on the warning side of a two-way address.

structural_cues: 18:2 coordinates warning and glad news under the book's purpose; 18:4 repeats the warning verb and names a warned cohort.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition and a warning/glad-news pair; I carry the severe consequence into 18:4 as the repeated verb's scope. Alternatively, 18:4 may only identify an audience while leaving the consequence implicit.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers a verbal caution about a bad claim.
changed_reading.after: It assigns the claimants to the severe-consequence side of the book's paired warning and promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation denies disclosed knowledge to both speakers and fathers, then reduces the claim to a large word emerging from mouths and false attribution. Human lineage becomes the likely transmission channel for speech that projects lineage onto God.

activation_trace.role: Born descent anchors the divine-lineage content that the following human father-chain reframes.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic standard that the verse explicitly says is absent.
Fatherhood and nurture supply a real human lineage beside the alleged divine lineage and make intergenerational transmission visible.
An intelligible word broad enough for a whole statement packages the claim as a socially repeatable formula.
The mouth opening in speech makes the claim outward vocal production rather than disclosed knowledge.
False attribution identifies the repeated saying as an invented ascription.
The opposite of truth supplies the explicit verdict on the mouth-borne attribution.

structural_cues: 18:5 immediately resumes the claim with the speakers, their fathers, a mouth-emerging word, and an exclusive lie verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared ignorance across speakers and fathers; I infer intergenerational transmission as the arrow from fathers to the current formula. Alternatively, fathers and descendants may independently share ignorance without direct transmission.

changed_reading.before: The focus records one false theological assertion.
changed_reading.after: It exposes an inherited, mouth-level lineage formula that lacks disclosed knowledge while projecting human descent onto God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the charge, the addressee is restrained from destroying his own life in grief behind nonbelievers' traces. Warning thus becomes finite communicative care that seeks wakefulness without making the warner responsible for forcing belief.

activation_trace.role: Alarm that awakens caution anchors warning as care directed toward another's response.
Killing oneself from grief supplies the prohibited excess against which the warning function is bounded.
The living self supplies what must not be consumed by the failed reception of the warning.
A remaining trace of what has gone supplies the image of pursuing the departing audience beyond the warning's communicative limit.
Grief over loss supplies the affect that could turn warning care into self-erasure.

structural_cues: 18:6 follows the accusation and asks whether the messenger will consume himself because they do not believe this discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning followed by a restraint on grief; I infer a boundary between responsible alarm and coerced reception. Alternatively, 18:6 may console generally without defining the warning's mode.

changed_reading.before: Warning is only threat directed at the claimants.
changed_reading.after: Warning is also bounded care: sound the danger, but do not destroy the warner in pursuit of assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths name exclusive lordship and call contrary speech an overstep; their people then become the explicit subjects who take gods. The exact acquisition root reverses agency from the focus allegation, making 'God took offspring' readable as projection of human god-making onto God.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself anchors the act alleged of God.
Born offspring identifies the relation attached to the alleged divine acquisition.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the youths' positive category for relation to the God of heavens and earth.
Excessive passage beyond a boundary classifies rival divine speech as a categorical overreach.
Humans acquiring gods for themselves supplies the reversed, actual agency that mirrors the act they attribute to God.
Compelling proof supplies the demanded authorization that their acquired deities lack.
Inventing a lie supplies the named mechanism by which unsupported divine relations are manufactured.

structural_cues: 18:4 makes God the alleged subject of اتخذ; 18:15 makes the human community the actual subject of the same root when taking gods.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reversed agency, exclusive lordship, absent proof, and fabrication; I infer projection from human relation-making to the alleged divine act. Alternatively, the parallel may condemn two distinct claims without implying psychological projection.

changed_reading.before: The claim independently assigns offspring to God.
changed_reading.after: The claim projects the human practice of acquiring and authorizing gods back onto God as an alleged acquisition of offspring.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cave dialogue repeatedly moves from human estimates to 'the Lord knows best'; later sayings about hidden number are stone-throwing conjecture, debate is bounded, and final speech assigns hidden knowledge to God. Because 18:4 begins with قالوا, its error becomes speech beyond human epistemic jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: Speech as a held doctrine anchors the claim whose authority is being audited.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the youths' correction from estimate to their Lord's superior knowledge.
Saying that operates as conjecture supplies the series of unstable numerical claims before the corrective command to speak.
Speaking by conjecture about the unseen supplies the packet's explicit model of unauthorized assertion.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the inaccessible domain about which the guesses are thrown.
Sharp verbal disputation supplies the practice that is explicitly restricted once knowledge runs out.
Knowledge disclosed to its possessor culminates in the command to assign superior knowledge to God.

structural_cues: 18:5 denies knowledge, 18:19 self-corrects an estimate, 18:22 limits unseen speculation, 18:23-24 conditions future speech, and 18:26 returns knowledge to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated speech-and-knowledge discipline; I apply that emerging rule backward to the claim in 18:4. Alternatively, the later restrictions may govern cave details and future plans without defining every theological utterance.

changed_reading.before: The claim is wrong because its content is false.
changed_reading.after: It is also a jurisdictional offense: finite speakers assert a hidden divine relation without access, proof, or disciplined qualification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exclusive lordship is followed by the absence of any alternative guardian and the refusal of every partner in judgment. A child attribution can thus carry a possible status or succession implication, not only biological descent, and the context closes that route to shared rule.

activation_trace.role: Born offspring anchors filial status and its possible relational entailments.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the exclusive positive authority named by the youths.
Taking charge and governing supplies the unavailable guardian-guide role for one left unguided.
Taking charge supplies the explicitly negated alternative authority besides God.
Association with God supplies the explicitly refused sharing relation in judgment.
Judgment and adjudication supply the sovereign domain in which no partner is admitted.

structural_cues: The pericope moves from exclusive lordship in 18:14 to no guardian besides Him and no participant in His judgment in 18:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exclusive lordship, absent alternative guardianship, and unshared judgment; I infer that filial attribution may imply co-status or succession. Alternatively, ولد may be denied solely as lineage without a governance entailment.

changed_reading.before: The warning rejects a biological family statement.
changed_reading.after: It also blocks any filial route to divine co-status, succession, guardianship, or shared judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins two form-distant bodily/legal branches rather than the ordinary warning and speech senses. It remains anchored in يُنذِرَ, قالوا, and the adjacent كَلِمَة, but downstream prose should present only a metaphorical liability resonance, never translate the claim as a literal wound or impose a legal compensation ruling.

activation_trace.role: A wound carrying obligatory compensation gives the warning an exploratory image of notice that consequential speech has incurred liability.
Articulated speech supplies the act through which the figurative injury is made.
A bodily wound in the word-root supplies the adjacent image of an utterance that cuts rather than merely misdescribes.

changed_reading.before: The warning answers an incorrect utterance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it serves notice that the utterance wounds the relational order it names and therefore bears consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the context forms mean mercy, while the cited branch carries womb and kinship. It remains anchored by the focus's born-offspring branch and the Lord's mercy spreading in refuge; render it only as a lexical rerouting from bodily kinship to non-genealogical care, not as an etymological definition or biological claim about God.

activation_trace.role: Born offspring supplies the literal genealogical relation being refused.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply a non-filial mode of divine care.
Womb and kinship imagery supplies the branch-distant bodily resonance that the source form redirects into divine mercy.
Refuge supplies the spatial realization of care without genealogy.

changed_reading.before: Rejecting offspring removes familial imagery from divine-human relation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the context reroutes intimacy from literal descent into the Lord's sheltering mercy and nurture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 18:4 states no motive of succession or immortality. It remains anchored in ولد as something generated from another while the narrative stages awakening, long preservation, and a true future promise; downstream prose should call it a possible anti-succession resonance, not an asserted motive of the speakers.

activation_trace.role: Something produced from another supplies the derivative-continuity image latent in offspring.
Rousing the still from repose supplies continuity by divine reactivation rather than descent.
The paired awakening and dispatch uses span restored life and renewed agency, extending the non-genealogical continuity mechanism.
Truth fixed in reality validates the promised future disclosed by the sleepers' preservation.

changed_reading.before: The verse only excludes a descendant from God.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also rejects lineage as a projected continuity mechanism where the narrative displays preservation and renewed life as direct divine acts.

strongest_changes: The upright, curvature-free delivered book makes the offspring claim the first named semantic bend.
The agency of اتخذ reverses in 18:15: humans take gods, exposing the focus allegation as projected human relation-making.
The no-knowledge and guessing-at-the-unseen sequence turns قالوا into an epistemic transgression, not merely false content.
summary.what_was_special: The focus itself collides acquired possession with born derivation; nearby fathers, reversed acquisition, disciplined speech, exclusive rule, mercy, and resurrection then split that collision into social, epistemic, relational, and exploratory material mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The fathers in 18:5 may mark shared ignorance without proving direct intergenerational transmission.
Filial status may not entail succession or shared governance in the focus wording.
The wound and womb traces are intentionally branch-distant and must remain qualified metaphorical activations.
